identity.name: Gasthaus Zum Lahmen Greifen
identity.description: The village inn: low beams black with a century of smoke, a fire spitting in the hearth, rain drumming the shutters. Wirtin Travine polishes a mug that is already clean and watches the door. Above the bar hangs a griffin carved with only one leg — nobody remembers why.

morning: The smell of porridge and woodsmoke fills the taproom.
afternoon: A pair of woodcutters argue softly over watered beer.
evening: Travine lights the tallow candles one by one.
night: The fire burns low; the one-legged griffin's shadow dances on the beams.

art.prompt: Interior of a medieval German tavern at night, low black beams, hearth fire, rain on shutters, a stern innkeeper woman behind the bar, carved one-legged griffin sign, dark fairy tale, oil painting style, warm candlelight against deep shadow

identity.name: Dorfplatz von Weyhersbrunn
identity.description: A muddy square around a moss-eaten well. Timbered houses lean together under the rain; a shrine of the Twelve stands by the well, its candles drowned. To the east, past the last fence, the Finsterwald begins like a wall of night. Miller Bodo stands under the shrine roof, wringing his cap.

connections.label: Into the inn Zum Lahmen Greifen
East, onto the forest path into the Finsterwald

art.prompt: A muddy medieval German village square in rain, moss-covered well, half-timbered houses, small roadside shrine with drowned candles, a dark forest wall in the background, dark fairy tale, oil painting style

morning: Chickens pick between the cobbles; somewhere a well-rope creaks.
afternoon: A cart rattles across the square and is gone.
evening: The shrine candles gutter as the light fails.
night: Rain and darkness own the square; every shutter is barred.

identity.name: Waldpfad im Finsterwald
identity.description: The path into the Finsterwald: firs so tall they swallow the sky, roots like knuckles, resin and rot. Goblin tracks — small, clawed, many — cross the mud and lead toward the old mill. Somewhere off the path, something keeps pace with you.

connections.label: Down the overgrown track to the old mill

ambient: Something keeps pace with you off the path, then stops.
A jay screams once, deep in the firs.
Resin drips; the woods breathe cold.

art.prompt: A dark path through an ancient German fir forest, towering black trees, twisted roots, mist, small clawed goblin tracks in mud, ominous dark fairy tale mood, oil painting style

identity.name: Die alte Mühle
identity.description: Bodo's mill hunches over its stream, wheel stopped, sails of cobweb in the doorway. Goblin filth is smeared on the millstones and something has scratched spiral marks into the door — again and again, as if in fear. Smoke curls from a hole in the roof: someone is living in there.

connections.label: Back up the track into the forest

ambient: The stopped wheel groans against the stream.
The spiral scratches on the door seem fresher than they should.

art.prompt: An abandoned medieval water mill in a dark forest clearing at dusk, stopped water wheel, cobwebbed doorway, smoke from a hole in the roof, strange spiral scratches on the door, dark fairy tale, oil painting style

identity.name: Alrik
identity.description: A young warrior out of Gareth with a plain arming sword, a patched cloak, and debts that made the road look attractive. The Wirtin's notice said 'goblins'; the pay said 'enough'.

list.name: Schwerthieb
list.special: A clean cut with the arming sword.

list.name: Wuchtschlag
list.special: Everything behind one blow — slower, but it lands like a falling beam.

list.name: Finte
list.special: A feint that leaves the enemy stumbling past you.

art.prompt: Portrait of a young medieval German swordsman, patched traveling cloak, plain arming sword, determined tired eyes

identity.name: Anderthalbhänder
identity.description: A plain, honest hand-and-a-half sword, pommel worn smooth. It has outlived two owners; Alrik intends to break the pattern.

identity.name: Heiltrank
identity.description: A stoppered clay flask of Travine's 'good schnapps' — which is, in fact, a genuine healing draught worth more than the inn. Restores 2d6 LeP.

identity.name: Wirtin Travine
identity.description: The innkeeper of the Lame Griffin: grey braid, forearms like a smith, an apron that has seen knife fights. She posted the notice that brought you here.

persona.personality: Dry, practical, protective of her village. Trades information for coin or usefulness, kindness for neither.
persona.backstory: Ran the inn alone since her husband walked into the Finsterwald twelve winters ago and came back wrong for three days before dying. She does not talk about it sober.
persona.voice: Clipped rural Garethi; calls everyone 'Held' (hero) with an audible eye-roll.

facts: The goblins took over Bodo's mill about a moon ago — before that, they never dared leave the deep woods.
Miller Bodo is out on the square wringing his cap; the mill deed and his mother's amulet are still inside the mill.
Twenty silver thalers for whoever clears the mill — village council's word, and she holds the purse.
secrets: Old Mother Sanne says the goblins are not squatting in the mill — they are HIDING in it, from something deeper in the forest.
The 'schnapps' behind the bar is a real healing draught; she'll part with it only if she likes you or fears for you.

list.name: Fäusterprobe
list.special: A barkeep's right hook, well practiced.

art.prompt: Portrait of a stern middle-aged medieval German innkeeper woman, grey braid, strong forearms, worn apron, tavern candlelight

identity.name: Müller Bodo
identity.description: A flour-pale, heavyset miller with red-rimmed eyes and a cap he has wrung into a rope. His mill is his whole life, and something with yellow eyes is sleeping in it.

persona.personality: Anxious, honest, embarrassingly grateful for any kindness. Wrings his cap when he lies, which is rarely and badly.
persona.backstory: Third-generation miller. Fled the mill in the night a moon ago when the goblins came — left everything, including his late mother's amulet, which he is ashamed to admit he wants back more than the mill.

facts: There are at least three goblins in the mill — he counted the eyes in the dark and stopped at six.
The mill's side door by the stream — the steg — doesn't latch; you can slip in over the footbridge.
His mother's amulet hangs on a nail by the grindstone — bronze, shaped like a wheel of Travia.
secrets: The night he fled, he heard the goblins SCREAMING in the deep woods first — they came to the mill running FROM something.
He has drawn the spiral mark he saw scratched on his door before — on the old boundary stone deep in the Finsterwald, when he was a boy.

art.prompt: Portrait of an anxious heavyset medieval miller, flour-pale face, red-rimmed eyes, wrung woolen cap in his hands, rain-wet

identity.name: Goblin-Anführer Rratz
identity.description: The biggest of the mill goblins — which is not saying much — wearing Bodo's Sunday hat and carrying a cleaver like a sword. His yellow eyes keep darting to the forest, not the door.

persona.personality: Bullying, twitchy, more afraid of the woods than of you — and that fear makes him vicious.
persona.voice: Shrill broken Garethi: 'Weg! Mühle UNSER! Draußen SCHLIMMER!'

facts: The mill is ours now. The village-things are soft.
secrets: We ran from the spiral-thing at the boundary stone. The mill's iron and running water keep it out. We are NOT leaving.

list.name: Hackbeil
list.special: Bodo's meat cleaver, swung with spite.

art.prompt: Portrait of a snarling red-furred goblin chief wearing a stolen Sunday hat, yellow darting eyes, cleaver over shoulder

identity.name: Goblin Fetz
identity.description: A scrawny goblin draped in stolen flour sacks, fast as a rat and about as brave.

persona.personality: Cowardly, sneaky, goes for the back of your knee.
persona.voice: Hissing giggles; two words of Garethi, both insults.

facts: Rratz says fight, Fetz fights. A little.
secrets: If Rratz falls, Fetz runs. Fetz has ALWAYS been a runner.

list.name: Rostiger Dolch
list.special: A rusty stab from behind a millstone.

art.prompt: Portrait of a scrawny cowardly goblin draped in flour sacks, hissing grin, one ear notched

identity.name: Goblin Knirps
identity.description: The runt: one ear, one club, both notched. It sleeps on the footbridge and bites anything that crosses.

persona.personality: Dim, loyal to Rratz, fights until Rratz doesn't.

secrets: The water under the bridge is the only place the spiral-dreams don't reach.

art.prompt: Portrait of a dim one-eared runt goblin clutching a notched club, guarding a footbridge

identity.name: Travia-Amulett
identity.description: A bronze amulet shaped like Travia's wheel, hanging on a nail by the grindstone — Bodo's mother wore it for fifty years of good bread and bad winters. It is warm to the touch, which a hanging piece of bronze in a cold mill should not be.

identity.name: Die alte Mühle
identity.description: Goblins have driven Miller Bodo from his mill at the edge of the Finsterwald. Clear them out, recover his mother's amulet — and find out what made forest goblins bold enough, or desperate enough, to move into a human mill.

steps: Reach the old mill beyond the forest path.
Drive the goblins from the mill.
Recover Bodo's Travia amulet from the grindstone.
